title: result
description: Resident to client: how a request's run ended. result is the object flash --json prints.

id.description: Chosen by the client, 1 to 128 bytes; the reply carries it back. Distinct among the connection's requests in flight.

status.description: succeeded: it ran (exit 0). failed: it ran and failed, or found nothing to act on (exit 1). rejected: the words name no command, or more than one (exit 2). local: a query the client runs itself, named by query.

message.description: Why it failed or was rejected.

query.description: For local: the query's words, such as config check or events watch.
